name: Wakasa Towa
source:
17 years old in the English version.

A member of the Junior Jr. Boys, a famous pop group. He's cheerful, confident, and energetic when on stage or in front of a camera, but when things go wrong, he scares easily. He's been known to stir up trouble for his own amusement, but would never tell a lie to hurt someone.

[From [url=http://sweet-fuse.com/]official website[/url]]
